topic: Figma Code Connect Investigation & Adoption Strategy
options_evaluated: USE_NOW (Rejected: No production UI code exists yet; nothing to connect)
DO_NOT_USE (Rejected: Code Connect provides valuable Dev Mode bridge once production components exist)
USE_LATER / REVIEW_AT_M5 (Selected: Re-evaluate when production Android Compose and iOS SwiftUI component foundations are bootstrapped at M5)

rationale.current_stage: Wave M0/M0.5 is focused on architecture, design workspace structure, and truth contracts. Zero production composables or SwiftUI views exist in the repository.
code_connect_prerequisites: Stable Figma component set in the O-TRAVELZ design system
rationale.overhead_evaluation: Implementing Code Connect files (*.figma.kt, *.figma.swift) prematurely adds maintenance churn while component props are evolving during M1-M4 exploration.

trigger_conditions_for_m5_review: Android and iOS projects successfully bootstrapped with basic design system tokens
Figma components published and versioned in Team Library
Automated CLI build pipeline capable of running @figma/code-connect publish
